subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & security requirements - ACME Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acmehealth.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & security requirements - ACME Health

Hi Jane / Tom —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and to capture next steps. Please reply with any corrections.

Key pain points you surfaced:
- Auditability: need detailed, exportable audit logs for user and admin activity (retention target: 7 years).
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 Type II, pen test evidence, and subprocessor list required for procurement.
- Data residency & retention: customer data kept in US regions; retention/export requirements for logs and records.
- Contract & DPA: ACME has standard DPA redlines and need to understand what we can accept.

Goals from ACME:
- Production pilot in Q3 with Private deployment (VPC) and strict logging/retention controls.
- Demonstrable evidence for security review to close procurement by end of July.

What Redwood will provide (agreed next steps):
1) Share SOC 2 Type II certificate and control mapping (attached).
2) Provide pen test summary and redacted report; full report available under NDA (attached: redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf).
3) Share draft DPA for your legal review (attached: redwood_dpa_draft.pdf).
4) Confirm audit log formats, retention options (we support configurable retention and export to S3) and a short tech note from our SEs.
5) Schedule a 30-min follow-up on Thurs 2027-06-03 to walk security team through evidence and controls.

Attachments: acme_soc2_questions.xlsx (your questionnaire), redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf, redwood_dpa_draft.pdf

Please confirm availability for the 6/3 slot (I’ve tentatively proposed 10am PT).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & security requirements - ACME Health

Thanks, Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifying Qs before we loop in our InfoSec folks:

1) Pen test: can you confirm the date and scope (internet-facing only vs. internal/cloud infra)? We’ll need the date and whether any high/critical findings were remediated. Redacted report is fine behind NDA.
2) SOC 2 Type II: what is the period covered by the report and the control mapping? We need to confirm no critical gaps for data retention and admin access controls.
3) Audit logs: can logs be exported in raw JSON to our S3 with object-level timestamps? Is log retention configurable up to 7 years or do you have archival workflows?
4) DPA: we’ll send our redlines — are you able to accept our standard clause on subprocessors and audit rights?

We are aiming to get our security review complete by 7/15 to hit the procurement timeline. I’m available 6/3 at 10am PT for the follow-up but our security director may request 45 mins.

Best,
Jane Smith
Senior Security Manager, Acme Health
jane.smith@acmehealth.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acmehealth.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & security requirements - ACME Health

Hi Jane — looping in a few quick technical answers, happy to deep-dive on the follow-up call.

- Pen test: Last full pen test was performed by SecureLabs on 2027-04-12. Scope included external app endpoints and our serving/control plane. No critical findings; two medium findings (dependency patching) were closed within 30 days. Redacted summary attached (redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf). Full report available under NDA.
- SOC 2: Redwood holds SOC 2 Type II (report period: 2026-11-01 to 2027-04-30). Certificate and a control mapping spreadsheet are attached. We also maintain a mapping to common healthcare controls (HIPAA adjacency) for your review.
- Audit logs: We emit structured JSON audit logs for admin and user events. Logs can be exported to a customer-owned S3 bucket (encrypted with customer-managed KMS) and retention is configurable; we support live retention up to 2 years and archival to S3 Glacier/Deep Archive for up to 7 years. Export includes object-level timestamps and request/response metadata.
- Data residency: Private deployment (VPC) option keeps data in the requested region (US-East or US-West).
- DPA/Subprocessors: We publish our subprocessors list and are open to reasonable audit rights. Specific redlines will require legal review; we typically accept standard customer audits with notice and scoping constraints.

Next steps from SE side:
- I’ll upload a short technical note describing log fields and an example S3 export manifest to the shared Drive before EOD.
- If you need the full pen test report, we can provide under a standard NDA (I’ll include the NDA template).

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acmehealth.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & security requirements - ACME Health

Great — thanks Jane and Rishi. Confirming next steps/owners: 
- Marissa: coordinate meeting invite for 6/03 10:00am PT (45 mins) and attach SE note + pen test summary.
- Rishi: upload technical log spec and S3 export sample to Drive; prepare NDA template for full pen test if requested.
- Legal (Redwood): review DPA redlines once ACME shares them (Marissa will route).

Deliverables timeline: SOC 2 cert + control mapping (today), pen test summary (today), technical log spec (EOD 5/30), NDA template (EOD 5/30), DPA draft already attached.

If that looks right, I’ll send the calendar invite and move the doc links into the folder I shared.

Thanks —
Marissa
